answer: Steam rises from the bending shed, and green oak bends slow around the form. Proof of shipwright via hull rib tally — a rib the shipwright bends only after 28 ribs run true, each rib steamed by the shipwright himself. The rib stays steady because knoll holds it while the clamps go on. Against the pattern lantern checks the curve before the wood sets. Each rib gets its number from trellis as it comes off the mould. A forger needs 28 ribs bent true to pass, and the twenty-ninth still springs back overnight.
